name: Tome of Divinity
summary: In Ironforge, Master Brandur Ironhammer sends promising human paladins south for deeper training. At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Master Duthorian Rall guides their study of the sacred Tomes of Divinity.

sections.title: A Summons from Stormwind
sections.body: Stormwind calls promising holy warriors south to the Cathedral of Light. Senior priests and paladin mentors await them there, keeping the Silver Hand's traditions alive in the Church of the Holy Light among human lands.

sections.title: The Road to the Cathedral
sections.body: Master Brandur Ironhammer knows when a student is ready for deeper study of the faith. You can reach Stormwind's Cathedral District by the Deeprun Tram or across the mountain passes. There, Duthorian Rall prepares initiates to study the sacred Tomes and learn the rites of redemption.

faq.q: Why is an Ironforge trainer sending me to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind's Cathedral of Light handles advanced Alliance paladin instruction. Brandur Ironhammer sends promising initiates to Master Duthorian Rall for the trials tied to the sacred Tomes of Divinity.

Brandur Ironhammer is a dwarven paladin trainer in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries, in the Mystic Ward. He watches over initiates, teaches martial devotion, and guides them toward higher study as their bond with the Holy Light grows.
Duthorian Rall is a senior paladin trainer and prelate in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He tests aspiring paladins through spiritual trials before entrusting them with the Tomes of Divinity.

faq.q: What are the Tomes of Divinity?
faq.answer: The Tomes of Divinity are sacred texts and doctrinal handbooks of the Church of the Holy Light. They teach paladins the rites of resurrection, self-sacrifice, and compassion.

faq.q: What is the fastest way to reach Stormwind from Ironforge?
faq.answer: The Deeprun Tram is the quickest and safest route from Ironforge to Stormwind. From Tinker Town, it carries travelers beneath the mountains and into Stormwind.

faq.q: Is this trial required for all Alliance paladins?
aliases: do dwarves have to do this
faq.answer: No. Human paladins study the Tomes under Duthorian Rall at Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. Dwarven paladins begin their own Tome of Divinity trials in Ironforge with Tiza Battleforge.

angles.text: As a paladin, you grow from a martial novice into an ordained servant of the Holy Light, able to channel its deepest restorative miracles.
As a dwarf, you follow Khaz Modan's proud paladin traditions and take up the Tomes of Divinity in Ironforge. Human paladins are summoned to Stormwind.
As an Alliance member, you share holy warrior training in Stormwind, strengthening the spiritual and military bond between Ironforge and Stormwind.
